notes.title: You will be rolling soon!
notes.content:
[h1]Happy New Year[/h1][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32100846/1eac1a6f6336ff8761bf4027fccf8b0b6ada68a5.png[/img]

We're launching Bacon Roll: Year of the Pig for Chinese New Year. Hope everyone enjoys this fun adventure, rolling across various worlds, shooting tomatoes, saving a princess. Sounds like a normal day to me. For a pig.

We're really excited to finally release this, we've made some smaller games in the past, but adding an in game currency system, unlockables, costumes, shooting etc... Has been quite a learning curve and we look forward to seeing what everyone thinks.
 
Enjoy!

FoV
